name: 15139 · Oakmont, PA
findings: ZIP 15139 (Oakmont) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15139 (Oakmont) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15139 (Oakmont) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 9% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
